lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in approximately 10-12 visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The blobs exhibit a staggered distribution with higher density in the area immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal axes of high-luminance blobs, forming a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank between the primary and secondary carinae.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible across the upper and mid-flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) visible beneath the ventral surface and trailing the pectoral fin.
